title: Reindexing the failure indicator
statement: Let $m,n$ be natural numbers, let $e:[m]\\to[n]$ be a bijection, let $f:\\{-1,1\\}^m\\to\\{\\pm1\\}$ be a Boolean function, let $k$ be a natural number, and let $\\rho:[n]\\to\\{\\text{free},\\text{fixed }1,\\text{fixed }-1\\}$ be a coordinate restriction. Reindexing $f$ along $e$ and then restricting by $\\rho$ gives the same coordinate-switching failure indicator at threshold $k$ as restricting $f$ by the restriction $i\\mapsto\\rho(e(i))$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean function on the m-dimensional sign cube
